meta.title: How a CDN makes websites fast

segments.speech: Why does a website load fast in Tokyo, and just as fast in Paris?
segments.caption: Why does a website load fast in Tokyo, and just as fast in Paris?

segments.speech: Your site lives on one origin server. If that server is far away, every request must travel thousands of miles, and back. That delay is called latency.
segments.caption: Your site lives on one origin server. If that server is far away, every request must travel thousands of miles, and back. That delay is called latency.

segments.speech: From Tokyo to a server in Virginia, one round trip takes around two hundred milliseconds. And a single page needs dozens of them.
segments.caption: From Tokyo to a server in Virginia, one round trip takes around two hundred milliseconds. And a single page needs dozens of them.

segments.speech: A C D N fixes this. It places edge servers close to your users, each one holding copies of your files.
segments.caption: A CDN fixes this. It places edge servers close to your users, each one holding copies of your files.

segments.speech: First visit? That is a cache miss. The edge asks the origin once, then keeps a copy.
segments.caption: First visit? That is a cache miss. The edge asks the origin once, then keeps a copy.

segments.speech: Next visit? That is a cache hit. The edge already has the file, and answers right away.
segments.caption: Next visit? That is a cache hit. The edge already has the file, and answers right away.

segments.speech: Now a million visitors can share one copy, and the origin barely notices.
segments.caption: Now a million visitors can share one copy, and the origin barely notices.

segments.speech: The result: pages load in milliseconds, and the origin handles far less traffic. Everyone gets the fast version.
segments.caption: The result: pages load in milliseconds, and the origin handles far less traffic. Everyone gets the fast version.

segments.speech: A CDN. Content, closer to everyone.
segments.caption: A CDN. Content, closer to everyone.
